2609.31383.title: Guiding End-to-End Driving Models with Endpoint-Constrained Trajectory Optimization
2609.31383.paper_summary: End-to-end driving policies are commonly trained through open-loop behavior cloning, yet they must ultimately operate in closed-loop when deployed on a vehicle, creating a fundamental mismatch between training and execution. Beyond the commonly studied effects of covariate shift and causal confusion, we identify a complementary factor for this open-loop/closed-loop gap: waypoint-based supervision and displacement metrics do not ensure that the intermediate trajectory is physically coherent or easy for the controller to track. We observe that these inconsistencies concentrate primarily at intermediate waypoints, while the predicted endpoint remains comparatively reliable. Based on this observation, we introduce Endpoint-Constrained Optimization (ECO), a lightweight postprocessing layer that anchors the trajectory to the vehicle's executed history, preserves the policy's predicted endpoint, and reshapes the intermediate waypoints to improve feasibility. ECO requires no map, privileged simulator state, or additional training, and can be inserted between a broad range of waypoint-emitting policies and their controllers. Across two closed-loop simulators, it improves the aggregate closed-loop score of all six evaluated generative and regression-based driving policies, and the gains tend to increase with how often the base plans violate motion limits. On HUGSIM, ECO improves VaVAM from 18.1 to 31.0 HD-Score (+71%), achieving 1st place on the HUGSIM Closed-Loop Driving Challenge. Similarly, on AlpaSim, ECO increases the scene scores of VaVAM and DiffusionDrive by 123% and 22%, respectively. These results show that for a broad collection of end-to-end driving models, repairing the intermediate geometry of predicted trajectories without changing the policy's predicted endpoint can substantially improve closed-loop performance.
2609.31383.paper_summary_zh: 端到端駕駛策略通常通過開環行為克隆進行訓練，但在部署到車輛時最終必須在閉環中運行，這造成了訓練和執行之間的根本不匹配。除了常見的協變轉移和因果混淆的影響外，我們還確定了一個補充因素，這個開環/閉環差距：基於路徑點的監督和位移指標並不能確保中間軌跡在物理上是一致的，或對控制器來說易於跟踪。我們觀察到這些不一致主要集中在中間路徑點，而預測的終點相對可靠。基於這一觀察，我們引入了端點約束優化（ECO），這是一個輕量級的後處理層，將軌跡固定在車輛的執行歷史上，保留策略的預測終點，並重塑中間路徑點以提高可行性。ECO不需要地圖、特權模擬器狀態或額外訓練，並且可以插入在廣泛的產生路徑點的策略和它們的控制器之間。在兩個閉環模擬器中，它提高了所有六種評估的生成和回歸基駕駛策略的總體閉環得分，且隨著基礎計劃違反運動限制的頻率增加，增益往往也會增加。在HUGSIM上，ECO將VaVAM的HD-Score從18.1提高到31.0（+71%），在HUGSIM閉環駕駛挑戰中獲得第一名。同樣，在AlpaSim上，ECO分別將VaVAM和DiffusionDrive的場景得分提高了123%和22%。這些結果顯示，對於廣泛的端到端駕駛模型，在不改變策略的預測終點的情況下修復預測軌跡的中間幾何形狀可以顯著改善閉環性能。
